scope_of_the_absence.depth: PRESENT. entry_book now carries bid_depth, ask_depth and a bounded ladder; the earlier 'no sizes in this corpus' claim was about the summary field, not the capture
scope_of_the_absence.consequence: the reward for these five sports markets is ZERO because no programme covered them -- not unknown. Every share figure quoted for them is TRANSFERRED from the culture / crypto / eFootball programmes, which cover different instruments.

period_exposure.basis: SIZE-WEIGHTED resting time across BOTH sides, reduced by partial fills and by cancellations; expressed as full-clip two-sided days
